test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure which will come next in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb2f4754d325715eec2ef3c44a229a238b8785093c0fd7f3f06fb031d1e058f3.png]
solution:
The logic followed is here:

**1st to 2ⁿd diagram -**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95331b54a4400c1fba735d22228fb9f684b37bfafd1631fcc496def0257bdbb2.png] 

(1) Rectangle length side both arrows change direction.

(2) Triangle left side arrow change here direction.

(3) Circle rotates anti-clockwise direction.

**2ⁿd to 3rd diagram –**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9d456fc96fb480f2a271c2edefa77f6264ba77a47ea86399cb1cb78eb3b096.png] 

(3) Rectangle width side both arrows change direction.

(4) Triangle left side arrow change here direction.

(5) Circle rotates anti-clockwise direction.

**3rd to 4th diagram –**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e038f98c62a085e7bf3023e6568ab1c84f2d0deac86ced6d3c02cf8374b490b.png] 

(6) Rectangle length side both arrows change direction.

(7) Triangle left side arrow change here direction.

(8) Circle rotates anti-clockwise direction.

Similarly,

**4th to 5th diagram –**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d267cb2f90c6d92f63432679a26aedadaeb14821fba29f99e639e14346d2b7a.png] 

(6) Rectangle width side both arrows change direction.

(7) Triangle left side arrow change here direction.

(8) Circle rotates anti-clockwise direction.

Hence, ‘**option 2**’ is the correct answer.
